evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We introduce Vestrum, a framework that turns failures in execution traces into scoped harness changes without training the task model.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across five settings and two baseline harnesses, the frozen harnesses improve held-out performance: UltraHorizon rises from 47.6 to 59.8 over GAM, Terminal-Bench 4 Hard from 63.7% to 70.3% of checks passed over Claude Code on eight held-out tasks at 1.03x test cost, and cell-type annotation agreement from 67.5% to 77.8% on held-out sections of one slide, alongside gains on LoCoMo and AMA-Bench.
